## Overview

Embodies the untamed world — wilderness, storms, beasts, raw natural forces.

## Domains
- Nature: Wilderness, beasts, plants, the natural order
- Tempest: Storms, wind, sea, destructive forces

## Personality
Wild, unpredictable, indifferent to mortal concerns. Exists as nature itself.

## Worship
Druids, rangers, sailors, farmers. Shrines in wild places. The world is the only temple.
